content.short: Itheum is an NFT infrastructure platform for data NFTs linked to dynamic real-world data.
content.description: Itheum delivers NFT infrastructure centered on Data NFTs that are linked to dynamic real-world data and unlockable by their owners. It enables creators like musicians and authors to mint their active data as Data NFTs, while gamers and athletes can mint their passive data as Data NFTs. This model helps build a web3 datalake of direct-from-source data, providing a counterpoint to traditional web2 data practices and enabling verifiable on-chain ownership, provenance, and monetization of personal or sourced data.
